description: Create unified localStorage utilities and integrate across all features
steps: Create src/utils/storage.ts with typed get/set/remove helpers
Define storage keys: wattwise_appliances (ApplianceItem[]), wattwise_budget (number), wattwise_history (number[]), wattwise_consumption (ConsumptionInput)
Implement safe defaults and try/catch around all JSON operations
Update CalculatorPage to load saved consumption on mount
Integrate storage utilities into all components that use localStorage
Test edge cases: corrupted data, missing keys, storage limits
acceptance_criteria: All localStorage operations use unified utilities
Data persists correctly across all features
Safe defaults work for missing or corrupted data
No console errors during storage operations
verification: Test persistence across page reloads for all data types
Verify safe defaults with corrupted localStorage data
Check no TypeScript errors in storage utilities
Test in incognito/private mode (no storage available)
